title: Restricted Predictor-Corrector Coupling-Window Orchestrator

restart_canonical.advance: F-CI55R accepted bottom-exchange canonical admission closeout

authoritative_plan.normal_cost: predictor plus one corrector SWAP trajectory per coupling window
authoritative_plan.failure: fail closed and request a smaller new outer coupling window; no same-window extra corrector loop in this workunit

scope.target: One restricted direct-coupling window with one SWAP predictor and one SWAP corrector, both originating from the same committed SWAP checkpoint, and two groundwater trials from the same committed groundwater checkpoint.

restricted_profile.time: finite generic model-time window [t0,t1], t1>t0; no midnight or calendar-day boundary
restricted_profile.head: typed common-datum hydraulic head through F-GC17; SWAP pressure-head conversion only through the admitted datum mapping
restricted_profile.flux: exact accepted whole-window SWAP bottom exchange from F-GC21P1; q_groundwater is exact opposite assignment of the derived whole-window mean q_swap
restricted_profile.head_convergence: F-GC17 explicit provenance-qualified head policy only; no numeric default

predictor_origin_state.requirement: The orchestrator owns or is given an accepted coupling-origin record containing h_groundwater(t0) and provenance matching the live SWAP and groundwater committed origins.
predictor_origin_state.first_window_rule: Initialization requires an explicit finite externally supplied accepted groundwater head bound to the captured origins. F-GC21 must not invent a head, infer it from pressure state, or silently query solver-private data.
predictor_origin_state.continuation_rule: After a successful coupled commit, the accepted corrector groundwater head and new committed provenance become the next-window origin record by deterministic assignment.

required_sequence: Capture one immutable SWAP checkpoint and one groundwater checkpoint at exactly t0; validate both against the accepted coupling-origin provenance before running a trial.
Predictor SWAP trial starts from the SWAP checkpoint and uses the accepted h_groundwater(t0) mapped through F-GC17 to the prescribed SWAP bottom pressure head.

Predictor publishes no committed state. Convert its exact accepted whole-window bottom_outward_exchange_native into a whole-window mean q_swap using the actual coupling-window duration; pair q_groundwater=-q_swap exactly through F-GC17.
Groundwater predictor trial starts from the same groundwater checkpoint and receives the paired predictor q_groundwater; its returned h_groundwater is the corrector head.
Rollback/discard the predictor SWAP and groundwater candidates after extracting their trial results; they are never commit candidates.
Corrector SWAP trial starts again from the same SWAP checkpoint and uses the predictor groundwater head mapped through F-GC17.
Groundwater corrector trial starts again from the same groundwater checkpoint and receives q_groundwater paired from the exact accepted corrector SWAP whole-window exchange.

Construct the interface state from h_swap equal to the prescribed corrector interface head, h_groundwater equal to the corrector groundwater result, q_swap equal to the exact whole-window mean corrector flux, and q_groundwater by exact opposite assignment.
Evaluate F-GC17 residuals and the explicit provenance-qualified head-convergence policy. Flux residual must be exactly zero by construction; no mass tolerance is permitted.

If head convergence fails or any participant fails, discard/rollback all uncommitted candidates and leave SWAP committed state, groundwater committed state, mass ledger and accepted coupling-origin state unchanged.
Only a converged corrector may be staged into the F-GC19R-R1 mass ledger using the exact corrector whole-window outward exchange converted from cm water depth to m water depth.

Prepare the groundwater corrector candidate and mass-ledger publication, then preflight every recoverable SWAP commit condition and every revision/counter exhaustion condition before the first irreversible publication.

Under exclusive runtime ownership, publish the prepared coupled result with no recoverable operation after the first irreversible commit; update the accepted coupling-origin record only by prevalidated deterministic assignment.
No process-crash or distributed two-phase-commit guarantee is claimed by F-GC21.

atomicity_requirements.exclusive_ownership: One orchestrator owns the SWAP committed state/candidate, groundwater service/checkpoint/prepared handle, ledger/prepared handle and coupling-origin record for the duration of publication; unsynchronised concurrent mutation is forbidden.
preflight: SWAP candidate ready and exact lineage/revision/time origin match
SWAP current revision has a representable successor
groundwater prepared handle ready and checkpoint still prepared at the same lineage/revision/window
next accepted coupling-origin record is finite and has representable provenance values
atomicity_requirements.abort_before_publication: Any recoverable failure before publication aborts/discards prepared participants and rolls back the SWAP candidate.
atomicity_requirements.post_first_commit: No recoverable status path is allowed after the first irreversible publication in the qualified in-process exclusive-owner path.

mass_and_units.source_exchange: kernel_result_t.bottom_outward_exchange_native, exact accepted whole-window SWAP outward exchange in native cm water depth
mass_and_units.mean_flux_rule: qbot_mean_cm_per_day = -bottom_outward_exchange_native/(t1-t0), then use the F-GC17 qbot-to-q_swap mapping and exact q_groundwater=-q_swap pairing

diagnostics_required: SWAP solver cost for each trajectory
predictor and corrector exact whole-window exchange and paired mean flux
predictor groundwater head, prescribed corrector head, corrector groundwater head
ledger conservation snapshot after accepted commit
qualification_cases: one predictor plus one corrector from the same SWAP checkpoint and same groundwater checkpoint
corrector head uses predictor groundwater response and no solver-private head
exact whole-window exchange rather than terminal-flux-times-window approximation
q_swap=-q_groundwater exact and ledger conservation residual exactly zero
head residual inside tolerance commits once
head residual outside tolerance rolls back everything and requests smaller outer window
SWAP stale lineage/revision/time candidate preflight failure
revision/counter exhaustion fail closed before publication
copied/stale prepared groundwater or ledger handle cannot cause duplicate publication
O0/O2 deterministic result identity for the qualified harness
all 30 SWAP Core Architecture Invariants re-audited
hard_nonclaims: No whole-window response tangent or sensitivity-corrector qualification; F-GC23 remains downstream.
No coupled restart/split-run persistence qualification; F-GC24 remains downstream.
No MultiSWAP cell/tile execution composition qualification; F-GC25 remains downstream.
No MODFLOW adapter or external groundwater-model conformance qualification; F-GC26 remains downstream.
No end-to-end production groundwater-coupling admission; F-GC27 remains downstream.
No crash-atomic or distributed transaction guarantee.
No application-specific numeric head tolerance is selected here; F-GC22 remains the authority for accuracy binding.
implementation_rule: Do not publish production source or claim owner qualification until the exact preregistered sequence, failure matrix, hard mass checks, provenance checks and all-30-invariant audit are executable and green on the owner branch.
